# Bitcoin flash crash sends BTC below $77K as liquidations spike

Bitcoin flash crash price action hit the market early Monday as BTC briefly lost the $77,000 level in a broad sell-off. Multiple feeds described the move as a flash crash, with the common thread being fast downside, forced unwinds, and a sharp deterioration in risk appetite across crypto.

The reaction was immediate across derivatives. [Yahoo Finance reported](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxNMnd2aGc5YTJFbWw3VTg2N1BsMG15VjhRZ0x2Y29MYzBKczdtd3MyMElmVTkxU2U3S053YU9QdEFDVEIyWEF6c0JKcTlWQkN3LTRZSXhsSUY2bUROQUZMQmtaRV9jQzNpMV9OYzFiand4eVo2VlhzM1FEY0lrbHkwaTJ2YTN1bXBsUzRRQzhCV1ZfamI3RUQxMEdZSjdydw?oc=5) that crypto long liquidations reached $584 million over 24 hours, while one intraday report from bloomingbit put the figure at $500 million in a single hour. That kind of compression usually signals crowded long positioning getting hit all at once.

This is not a protocol story. It is a market structure story driven by leverage, macro pressure, and traders moving to cut risk fast.
